messages:
Asha: Prospect (DataBank) needs a Dedicated POC. Must present client certs to their firewall and they want a single static egress IP. Native IPv6 is nice-to-have but not mandatory. Can we do this quickly?
Mark: Static IPv4 egress + customer-side mTLS proxy is the fastest. We can reserve an egress IP for the sandbox and they terminate mTLS on their proxy.
Renee: Confirming security: if they terminate mTLS upstream we require either (1) a signed X-Client-ID header + HMAC, or (2) our token-exchange flow where their proxy mTLSs to our auth and gets a short token. Both are auditable.
Asha: They asked about IP rotation risk. They need the IP stable for 7 days.
Mark: We can mark the reserved NAT IP as non-rotating for the POC window. Note: provider-level failover could force a swap, but we'll give 24h notice.
Asha: Can you send the minimal checklist we need from their network team?
Renee: Checklist (short): network diagram, CIDR to allow, proxy cert chain & rotation cadence, emergency revoke contact, preferred auth pattern (HMAC header or token). I'll attach full questionnaire after this thread.
Asha: Good. Can we share curl examples for both approaches?
Mark: Sure — header/HMAC approach example:
```bash
curl -v https://dedi-poc.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H "X-Client-ID: $(cat client.pem | base64)" \\
  -H "X-Client-HMAC: <HMAC(client-id + ts)>" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer DEDICATED-TEMP-KEY" \\
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
Mark: And token-exchange (proxy mTLS -> get token -> call):
```bash
# proxy obtains token via mTLS
curl --cert /path/proxy.crt --key /path/proxy.key https://auth.redwood.example/v1/token -d 'scope=dedi.poc'
# proxy calls API
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://dedi-poc.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Asha: ETA to stand up the sandbox if we pick the proxy route?
infra-bot: dedicated-sandbox:queued id=dp-621 ETA=5h
Mark: Once infra-bot finishes we'll provide the reserved egress IP and a temporary API key. If they later require native IPv6 + ingress mTLS we'll propose a Private sandbox (48-72h).
Asha: Thanks — I'll send this and ask which auth pattern they prefer. Will update here. :)
